# Membrane UDP plugin v0.14.4 - Table of Contents

> Membrane UDP plugin

## Pages

- [Membrane UDP plugin](https://membrane-udp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://membrane-udp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.UDP.Endpoint](https://membrane-udp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UDP.Endpoint.md): Element that sends buffers received on the input pad over a UDP socket and
reads packets from a UDP socket and sends their payloads through the output pad.
- [Membrane.UDP.Sink](https://membrane-udp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UDP.Sink.md): Element that sends buffers received on the input pad over a UDP socket.
- [Membrane.UDP.Source](https://membrane-udp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.UDP.Source.md): Element that reads packets from a UDP socket and sends their payloads through the output pad.
